verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated sandbox feature, but you can assemble one. CloudFormation and CDK let you spin up and tear down an isolated stack of resources. IAM policies and temporary role credentials can limit what a test identity can reach. The Free plan is described as a place to "build, break things, and experiment" with no charges. All of this is a do-it-yourself pattern rather than a first-class sandbox, and no hands-on corroboration exists. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or isolated test-environment feature, multi-account or environment separation guidance, test-data or production-data isolation tooling, and independent corroboration.
